status: God/Demigod/Utusan Tuhan share one user-requested Concept selector. Twelve concept entries are an assistant-proposed starter; count/roster and detailed capacities remain adjustable; base weights equal.

contract.scope: One canonical Concept selector for all authorized callers; caller-specific grant role, maximum override and saved return are explicit bindings, not copies of the wheel.
